profile.headline: Passionate software developer and natural leader always looking to improve and learn new things
profile.summary:
Experienced software engineer, natural leader and mentor seeking project's success by focusing on product's quality and by making sure the product satisfies with the actual business needs.
Based on my experience, the biggest and most common issue I have seen among colleges is that we tend to implement a requirement that is given to us or that we normally demand to have; however I strongly believe that to be a great software engineer we have to truly understand the problem statement behind the requirement so that it makes sense to us and only then we will be able to provide a suitable and comprehensive solution to such problem/business need.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a Senior Software Engineer, I'm known to be the expert in my area known as "Discovery services" which is a set of applications and services which objective is to interact with 3rd party vendors to gather driving records and other factors need to assess the risk of an applicant for underwriting and rating purposes. 
Currently I'm in charge of maintaining and growing existing the solutions in .Net framework 3.5, C#, SQL Server 2008, 2012, TSQL, Oracle and PL-SQL; as well as creating micro-services in AWS developed in Scala and Java, MongoDB and Jenkins following the Scrum - Agile software development methodology utilizing tools like Jira and Confluence for project tracking and documentation.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer and Technical Lead
positions.description:
I had the opportunity to work for several clients and projects assuming different roles and sometimes multiple roles within the same project from business analyst gathering and writing requirements all the way through development and implementation of the systems. Following are few of the most important projects I have participated in and the most relevant technologies utilized within the development cycle:
1. Client: Esurance, ~2 yeas, Position: Senior Software Engineer (Contractor), Technologies: .Net framework 2.0 and 3.5, C#, TSQL, SQL Server 2008 and 2012, WCF, Web and Windows Services, Visio, Enterprise Architect.
2. Client: Bancomer, 1 year, Position: Technical Lead and Senior Software Engineer, Technologies: .Net framework 2.0 and 3.5, C#, TSQL, SQL Server 2008 and 2012, WCF, N-Hibernate
3. Client: Cablemas, ~1 year, Position: Technical lead and Sr. software developer, Technologies: Java, J2EE, web services, JSP, Oracle 11g, PL-SQL, Enterprise Architect.
4. Client: FCTI Inc., ~1 year, Position: Sr. Software Developer, Technologies: .Net Framework 2.0, C#, N-Hibernate, SQL Server 2000 and 2008, T-SQL.
5. Client: BCI Systems Inc., ~1 year, Position: Sr. Software Developer, Technologies: .Net Framework 2.0, C#, javascript, WPF, SQL Server 2000 and 2008, T-SQL.

positions.title: Senior Java Developer and Team Lead
positions.description:
As technical lead and senior java developer, I was in charge of this huge project to automate end-to-end the preliminary investigation process within the state attorney general's office, interconnecting the different departments from prosecutors all the way through legal experts and police officers. 
We were recognized by an IT nation-wide distribution magazine for implementing a system of this nature in a record time and due to the high user approval ratings. 
Java desktop application J2SE with Oracle 10g

company.name: Procuraduria General de Justicia del Estado de Michoacan

positions.title: Unix System Administrator
positions.description:
managing HPUX and SOLARIS OS based servers. 
server level management (new app installations and patch updates)
data storage level management. Data storage partitioning and maintenance in a highly available topology

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Ciudad de Morelia, Michoacán de Ocampo, Mexico
positions.description:
As a Java developer I was in charge of creating end-to-end web based systems for different branches of the state government.
Technologies applied / Skills gained:
1. Requirements gathering and analysis
2. Produce design artifacts in UML
3. Application of several design patterns like singleton, facade and template
4. System implementation in Java, JSP, javascript coding languajes, tomcat as web server env. and Oracle based data storage
5. System maintenance by creating and leveraging monitoring systems to identify performance and business related potential issues as well as fixing any user reported issues.
